steps.instruction: Pick and place the flowers apart on the table so that each BLUE flower lies by itself, facing away from the camera, not touching or overlapping any other flower.
Grab ONLY the BLUE flowers and lift them directly above the mouth of the yellow bottle with SEVERAL inches of clearance between the bottom of the stem and the bottle.
EXTREMELY Slowly, lower the bottom of the blue flower's stem into the bottle mouth. Make SMALL, PRECISE movements.

done_instruction: Return both arms to the home position.
flowers_left_question: Are any BLUE flowers still on the table, outside the bottle? Answer with JSON: {"blue_flowers_left": bool}
system_prompt: You check a robot manipulation scene from three cameras: front, left_wrist and right_wrist. In the front image the robot's right arm appears on the left side and its left arm on the right side. Only blue flowers count; flowers already in the bottle do not count, and neither do flowers of other colors. Answer with exactly one JSON object and nothing else.
